newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet extends losses as NYMEX, diffs weaken.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet extends losses as NYMEX, diffs weaken.

text.p: Buyers backed out of the jet fuel market Tuesday as prices slid sharply on the NYMEX and on the differential basis.

NYMEX prices shed 2.50 cents as forecasts for moderate temperatures and heavy technical selling extended the bearish move that began Monday. The return of Iraqi crude to the market also lent some downward pressure to the futures.
Traders said the prices typically move either on the futures or the differential basis.
"But today, they hit both of them pretty hard," one market player said.

U.S. Gulf (USG) diffs for prompt 54-grade barrels ended Tuesday at about 2.00 cents under the screen, a drop of nearly 1.00 cent from its early morning level. Few active buyers were noted, though a small amount traded at 1.90 cents under.
USG 55-grade low sulphur material sat at 1.00 cent under the print by the end of the day, down from about flat with the screen in the morning.
New York Harbor prompt 54-grade jet fuel changed hands at 2.00 cents over the screen, down more than 0.50 cent on the day, with barrels for mid-December delivery talked about 1.50 cents over.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
